title: İnsanlık Yararına Teknolojiler Yarışması - Lise Seviyesi (Technology for Humanity Competition - High School Level)
organization: TEKNOFEST / T3 Vakfı (Türkiye Teknoloji Takımı Vakfı)
description: TEKNOFEST high-school-level technology competition with a hackathon-shaped format (team project build, finals presentation, prize purse). Explicitly open to all high school students (including Open Education/açık öğretim) studying in Turkey and abroad, plus graduates within 3 years. Teams up to 6 members plus an optional advisor (advisor mandatory for high-school teams per TEKNOFEST general rules).
residency_restrictions: Open to high school students studying in Turkey and to Turkish/international students studying abroad (page text: "Türkiye'de ve yurt dışında öğrenim gören"); exact abroad-eligibility scope not independently confirmed beyond the page's own wording, so treat 'abroad' eligibility as unconfirmed detail pending the full şartname (regulations) PDF.
application_requirements: project proposal/technical documents uploaded to TEKNOFEST KYS system
selectivity_evidence: Selection via submitted project proposal + finals presentation in Şanlıurfa; no published acceptance rate found. Not claiming a selectivity_tier above open_enrollment without a published rate.
verification_status: Verified - official TEKNOFEST competition page fetched and read directly, 2026-08-22. Cross-checked general high-school eligibility against TEKNOFEST's own FAQ (teknofest.org/tr/kurumsal/sss/), which confirms lise-level students are eligible for TEKNOFEST competitions generally.
notes: 2026 application deadline (2026-02-28) has already passed as of this research date; finals run 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-04, so the competition is mid-cycle, not open for new applicants right now. No 2027 cycle has been announced anywhere on the site as of 2026-08-22 — deliberately not inventing a next-cycle deadline; this record documents the real, dated 2026 cycle as historical/closed rather than as a currently-applicable opportunity. title: Teens in AI Global Techathon
description: Global AI hackathon/techathon program for teenagers, run as a series of national/regional techathon stages (e.g. Ukraine, Albania) feeding into an international competition and a Global Demo Day final. Teams of 5-6 with an educational mentor build AI-based solutions to real-world problems framed around the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
selectivity_evidence: No published acceptance rate found; open program with regional/national stages feeding a global final, not a gated admission process. Not claiming a selectivity_tier above open_enrollment.
verification_status: Verified - official teensinai.com homepage fetched directly, confirms explicit 13-18 age range in the org's own words ("young people aged 13-18"). 2026 cycle dates cross-confirmed independently for two national stages (Ukraine: national stage 2026-02-21/22, international round 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-17; Albania: national techathon 2026-02-13) plus a stated Global Demo Day final on 2026-04-23 — all already elapsed as of this research date (2026-08-22), so treated as historical for the 2026 cycle.
